row.reason: APi is a branch-based service and installation contractor. It does inspection, maintenance and installation of fire protection, life safety, HVAC, elevator and security systems. SPX is a manufacturer of engineered HVAC products and detection and measurement equipment, sold through distributors and reps. The only overlap is HVAC, and there SPX is an equipment supplier, not an installer or servicer. The two share some building-owner and contractor customers, but SPX has no fire, life-safety, elevator or security services. Its other main segment, detection and measurement (locators, fare collection, navigation lights), has no match at APi. Revenue models differ: product sales versus service contracts and installation projects.
